effect.dilate:size.comment: # Dilate Size; normalized 0-1 maps to 1.0 through 10.0

effect.particlesystem:particles.comment: # Particle System Particles; normalized 0-1 maps to 0.0 through 256.0

effect.particlesystem:lifetime.comment: # Particle System Lifetime; normalized 0-1 maps to 0.0 through 10.0

effect.particlesystem:xpos.comment: # Particle System X Pos; normalized 0-1 maps to -1.0 through 1.0

effect.particlesystem:ypos.comment: # Particle System Y Pos; normalized 0-1 maps to -1.0 through 1.0

effect.particlesystem:zpos.comment: # Particle System Z Pos; normalized 0-1 maps to -1.0 through 1.0

effect.particlesystem:xvelmin.comment: # Particle System X Vel Min; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.02 through 0.02

effect.particlesystem:xvelmax.comment: # Particle System X Vel Max; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.02 through 0.02

effect.particlesystem:yvelmin.comment: # Particle System Y Vel Min; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.02 through 0.02

effect.particlesystem:yvelmax.comment: # Particle System Y Vel Max; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.02 through 0.02

effect.particlesystem:zvelmin.comment: # Particle System Z Vel Min; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.02 through 0.02

effect.particlesystem:zvelmax.comment: # Particle System Z Vel Max; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.02 through 0.02

effect.particlesystem:rotatemin.comment: # Particle System Rotate Min; normalized 0-1 maps to -5.0 through 5.0

effect.particlesystem:rotatemax.comment: # Particle System Rotate Max; normalized 0-1 maps to -5.0 through 5.0

effect.particlesystem:scalemin.comment: # Particle System Scale Min; normalized 0-1 maps to 0.0 through 0.25

effect.particlesystem:scalemax.comment: # Particle System Scale Max; normalized 0-1 maps to 0.0 through 0.25

effect.particlesystem:gravity.comment: # Particle System Gravity; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.002 through 0.002

effect.particlesystem:wind.comment: # Particle System Wind; normalized 0-1 maps to -0.002 through 0.002

effect.shiftrgb:mode.comment: # Shift RGB Mode; 0=Shift X, 1=Shift Y, 2=Rotate X, 3=Rotate Y, 4=Rotate Z, 5=Zoom

global.interestlevel.comment: # Interesting level: minimum painting score for accepting random patches; lower is more permissive

global.randeffectcount.comment: # Number of distinct effect plugins in a random patch; capped at the available plugins

global.attractexittouches.comment: # touches needed to leave attract mode

global.attractvideodestination.comment: # where attract videos play: main (Resolume) or gui (GUI screen)

global.attractvideoresize.comment: # on the GUI screen, fill the top 2/3 with the attract video and show the venue logo below

global.sampleplaybackquant.comment: # sample playback quantize in beats, 0 disables quantize

global.sampleplaybackreverb.comment: # sample playback reverb wet amount, 0 disables reverb

global.sampleplaybackreverblength.comment: # sample playback reverb decay length multiplier, 1 is short and 4 is the default

global.sampleplaybackminmp3seconds.comment: # minimum MP3 duration in seconds for sample playback

global.wordthreshold.comment: # minimum peak 10 ms RMS loudness for word MP3 eligibility; 0 disables filtering

global.sampleplaybackvolume.comment: # master volume multiplier for sample playback

global.sampleplaybackspeedrange.comment: # how much of the half-speed..double-speed span the pad's vertical axis covers, 0 pins everything to normal speed

global.sampleplaybackspeedcenter.comment: # pad height that plays at normal speed, raise it to give more of the pad to slower speeds

global.sampleplaybackspeeddivisions.comment: # snap the pad's vertical axis to this many discrete speeds, 0 is continuous

global.deltaztrignote.comment: # pressure change threshold for note retriggering

global.deltaztrigcontroller.comment: # pressure change threshold for controller updates

global.deltaytrig.comment: # Y movement threshold for note retriggering

global.guidefaultlevel.comment: # GUI startup level: 0 = normal, 1 = advanced, 2 = performance

global.showthemes.comment: # offer the preset themes in the GUI

global.showgoatsbutton.comment: # offer the Show Goats button in the GUI

visual.shape.comment: # Rand uses randchoices; manual selection keeps all shapes

visual.shapedetail.comment: # secondary shape control, depends on shape

sound.samplesplitterdir.comment: # Directory under config/mp3 for SampleSplitter playback, enum filled in from config/mp3 at startup

sound.sampleplayer.comment: # play whole mp3 files one-shot, instead of splitting one file into words

sound.sampleplayerdir.comment: # Directory under config/mp3 for SamplePlayer playback, enum filled in from config/mp3 at startup

sound.samplerotate.comment: # SamplePlayer only - pick a random mp3 from sampleplayerdir on every note
